label: ANALYSIS RECORD
kind: independent re-analysis of the Exp A primary results (verifiability check)
timing: POST-RESULTS verifiability check, written and run on 2026-11-01 after the primary results were opened (about 06:05 UTC). It recomputes the preregistered primary quantities with independently written code. The check itself is not preregistered and adds no new inference.
independence: Written without opening scripts/expA_analyze.py, scripts/expA_score.py or any absent_edges/ analysis code. Method taken from the frozen TABLES.md Methods section (see method_spec). Data input: CELLS.jsonl only. ANALYSIS.json is read only to compare.

method_spec.unit: item mean over the primary seeds (completed cells) -> paired difference within item -> family mean -> equal-weight mean over families
method_spec.primary_test: two-sided one-sample t test on family mean differences (df = F - 1); Holm over the fixed family H1, H2, H3; 95% t intervals are marginal
method_spec.denominators: completed model exits other than Submitted score 0 (completed model exits per prereg: Submitted, NoAnswer, ContextLimit, FormatExhausted)
method_spec.seeds_and_contrasts: primary seeds 11, 23, 47; block P only; H1 = C3 - C2, H2 = C4a - C1, H3 = C1 - C0 (variant omit_node, except C0 with variant none); pairing by item_id
method_spec.p_rates: family-weighted rate of site_recovered per block-P condition: item mean over the primary seeds -> family mean -> equal-weight mean over families; 95% Student t interval over the family means (df = F - 1)

not_reverified: per-cell scoring: site_recovered is taken from CELLS.jsonl as given (episodes are not re-scored and scores.jsonl is not read)
sign-flip p-values and family-cluster bootstrap intervals (RNG-dependent sensitivity analyses)
secondary and exploratory blocks (S-VC, S-NAT, S-EDGE, T), costs, exposure audit, process descriptives
